title: Start
body:
Lupe’s parents compare him to his older cousin who always gets high grades.
He feels pressured and discouraged.
What should Lupe do?
[[ A. Lupe pretends he’s fine and keeps everything inside. |option4]]
[[ B. Lupe lies about his grades to avoid disappointment. |option5]]
[[ C. Lupe opens up about how he feels and asks for understanding instead of pressure. |option6]]
